body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete:

- GO:0006041 D-glucosamine metabolic process
- GO:0030389 fructosamine metabolic process
- GO:2001289 lipid X metabolic process
- GO:0006044 N-acetylglucosamine metabolic process
- GO:0006051 N-acetylmannosamine metabolic process
- GO:0006054 N-acetylneuraminate metabolic process
- GO:0019276 UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine metabolic process
- GO:0006047 UDP-N-acetylglucosamine metabolic process

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32273

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_93mtPnS4LBFafLA7bA0ewhZS9cKnBj5h3Fo_4kaoBc/edit?usp=sharing

TAIR | 9
FlyBase | 2
EcoCyc | 1


** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

| GO:0006047 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR020004 Bifunctional UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 2-epimerase/N-acetylmannosamine kinase > GO:UDP-N-acetylglucosamine metabolic process ; GO:0006047
| GO:0006051 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR007260 Putative N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate epimerase > GO:N-acetylmannosamine metabolic process ; GO:0006051



Thanks.
